nocobase-nocobase-app-app-skills-nocobas.description: Primary entry for building complete NocoBase 3 applications and individual features: business and administration pages, routes, components, endpoints, data, permissions, services, translations, and tests. Use this application-local workflow instead of globally installed NocoBase 2 Skills. For local or published NocoBase 3 plugin packages, use the project plugin development Skill.

nocobase-nocobase-nocobase-app-installer.description: Deploy a built NocoBase 3 application locally or over SSH to an offline Linux server, for production, with `@nocobase/app-installer` from the deployment archive `pnpm build --tar` writes, then upgrade, roll back and check it. Use when the user asks to deploy an application to production or a server, to upgrade or roll back such an installation, or when the directory holds an `installer.json` written by app-installer. Not for creating a project to develop, which is the `nocobase-create-app` Skill.

nocobase-nocobase-tools-create-plugin-te.description: Development draft for the plugin's App-facing capabilities.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-agent-sessi.description: Register the Agent Sessions plugin in a NocoBase App so people talk in the browser with the coding agents on their own computers (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode and more, on macOS, Linux or Windows; `<cli> acp service install` or `acp start`), route its page, tie the App's records to sessions with a link kind (registerLinkKind) that people can also mention with `#`, let sessions work for the App's projects (registerProjects), tell the agents how to work (registerInstructions), notify the owner (registerNotices), work out why a computer is offline, an agent is…

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-agents-noco.description: Register the Agents plugin in a NocoBase App and configure it (agents.* in config.yml), contribute subjects, scopes, business actions, agent defaults, the App's own agents, CLI commands and reports through agentsToken, enable the agents discovered from runners, configure OnlineAgentService and OnlineAgentConfigurator for SDK chats, business tools and native web search, set up model services for the App's own model calls, connect runners (registration tokens, protocol, upgrade_required), build and serve the CLI and runner tarballs (pnpm nocobase cli build, --runner), or work out why a run, a…

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-api-keys-no.description: Register the API Keys plugin in a NocoBase App, let scripts and integrations call the App's API with an x-api-key header, or work out why a key is rejected.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-authenticat.description: Build authentication requirements in a NocoBase 3 application: protect API routes and pages with the session, read and refresh the session in the browser, customize the login, registration and password pages, add sign-in methods such as social login, OIDC or a custom Better Auth plugin, enable official Better Auth plugins (device login for a CLI, bearer tokens, organizations, two-factor, passkeys) with the migration their tables need, manage account lifecycle from server code, and configure secrets, cookies and shared storage for deployment.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-authorizati.description: Design and implement NocoBase 3 business permissions: job responsibilities, pages, business actions, fields, record scopes, relations, team inheritance, permission assignments, administration and inspection. Use when building a system or feature whose users have different access.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-authz-defau.description: Design, implement and verify default access for NocoBase 3 business operations, including named data scopes and production administration.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-authz-restr.description: Design, implement and verify restriction rules for NocoBase 3 business operations, including named data scopes and production administration.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-authz-shari.description: Design, implement and verify sharing rules for NocoBase 3 business operations, including named data scopes and production administration.

nocobase-nocobase-examples-app-plugin-cl.description: Use when adding commands to an application's nocobase CLI, or when working out how a plugin contributes CLI commands. Covers the ./cli entry, defineCliPlugin, and how topics are assembled.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-concurrency.description: Configure and consume NocoBase 3 process-local Mutex locks, strict named managers, original service Token, optional TTL, public implementation extensions and application-owned shutdown.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-database-ex.description: Browse an application's database connections, collections, and fields read-only through the Database Explorer endpoints, and grant access to them.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-demo-mode-n.description: Build, enable or operate a dedicated NocoBase 3 demo deployment with @nocobase/app-plugin-demo-mode: a public, shared demo site whose fictional data is generated, cleared and reset, with quick visitor sign-in, write protection and optional model or Agent simulation (公开演示站、只读演示、定时重置的演示环境、 Demo Mode). Also use when changing business collections, external integrations or background jobs in an application that already depends on this plugin, so its demo dataset, cleanup and adapters stay complete. Not for example records (use the application development Skill's sample-data workflow), ordinary…

nocobase-nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-de.description: Migrate an older global NocoBase 3 plugin development Skill to the version supplied by the current App. Use when this legacy global entry is selected; it forwards to project guidance and contains no plugin implementation instructions.

nocobase-nocobase-app-app-skills-nocobas.description: Create and maintain NocoBase 3 plugins inside an existing App or a NocoBase 3 source workspace, including Client, Server, CLI, database resources, UI Library integration, Plugin Skills, and registration. Use for App-local plugins under packages/ and source-workspace plugins or examples. Not for creating an App, application-only feature work, or legacy NocoBase 2 plugins.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-file-nocoba.description: Add file collections, uploads, downloads, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX previews, business attachments, and editable UI Library file components to a NocoBase 3 App using the public File Repository services.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-foundation-.description: Use when an application should show its administrators which NocoBase Core capabilities it uses (the App Foundation page), when registering or moving that page, or when asked why a capability shows as in use, needing setup, not used or undetermined there. Not for business permissions or for building other admin pages.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-i18n-nocoba.description: Use when adding or changing user-facing text in a NocoBase application or plugin: writing locale files, wiring a package's locales for the first time, translating a component or a menu title, naming a namespace, translating server responses, errors and outbound mail, or adding a language. Not for building page UI around the text (nocobase-app-development) or scaffolding a new plugin (nocobase-app-plugin-development); those Skills hand translation work here.
nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-i18n-nocoba.tools: Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-mail-nocoba.description: Use when integrating the NocoBase 3 Mail plugin into an application: configure Gmail, Microsoft 365, or IMAP/SMTP accounts, embed mail UI, send from business code, or diagnose synchronization and delivery.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-notificatio.description: Use when agents need to integrate, configure, send, inspect, or diagnose NocoBase notifications based on app-plugin-notification.
Use when agents need to register, verify, or diagnose the NocoBase durable in-app inbox, its development-only Client page, or realtime refresh behavior.
Integrate encrypted browser push subscriptions and the Web Push notification channel in a NocoBase 3 application.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-projects-no.description: Register the Projects plugin in a NocoBase App, call its /api/projects API for projects, issues, their fixed statuses, labels and members, grant its permissions, or work out why a projects request is rejected.

nocobase-nocobase-examples-app-plugin-re.description: Use the NocoBase 3 Repository API example plugin to demonstrate array and streamed findMany queries, CRM and order CRUD, relation reads and writes, optimistic locking, atomic numeric updates, and aggregate queries.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler-n.description: Develop scheduled tasks in NocoBase 3 that business administrators need to view and track through the application UI. Define schedules in code, register the target a schedule points at, integrate execution status, and report completion. Do not use Scheduler to manage tasks that do not need UI visibility.

nocobase-nocobase-examples-app-plugin-sk.description: Use the Skills Example plugin to add its App Notice component, read its authenticated default Notice API, or consume its Server ServiceToken in a NocoBase App.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-template-pr.description: Use when implementing or debugging NocoBase 3 template printing with DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX templates and business data, including record/list output, attachments, QR codes, or PDF conversion; ordinary browser page printing is outside this workflow.

nocobase-nocobase-app-plugin-users-nocob.description: Integrate the Users plugin into a NocoBase App, build a user management page on its API and configure its permissions, or add an application-owned role scope through the public Server contracts.

nocobase-nocobase-app-app-skills-nocobas.description: Upgrade this application to a newer release of the template it was generated from, which is how this application moves to a newer NocoBase version. Users rarely think in terms of templates, so use it whenever the user asks to upgrade or update NocoBase, the NocoBase core, kernel or framework version, or the @nocobase packages as a whole — for example "upgrade NocoBase", "update the NocoBase core version", "move to the latest NocoBase release", "升级 NocoBase", "升级 NocoBase 内核版本", "更新 NocoBase 到最新版" — as well as when they ask to upgrade the template, pull in template changes, move to a newer…

nocobase-nocobase-nocobase-create-app.description: Create a NocoBase 3 project to develop, locally, with `pnpm create @nocobase/app@beta`, configure it with `pnpm nocobase config init`, `config set` and `config check`, start it, and hand over to the application's own guidance. Use when the user asks to install, create, set up or try NocoBase to develop with, and the working directory holds no NocoBase application yet. Not for deploying to production, which belongs to the `nocobase-app-installer` Skill. Not for NocoBase 2 or the `nb` CLI, and not for work inside an existing application, which carries its own AGENTS.md and Skills.

nocobase-nocobase-libs-db-nocobase-db.description: Work with the database in a NocoBase 3 application: configure connections and dialects, add migrations and seeds, declare schema with the Collection Builder, read and write records with Repository or QueryAdapter, run transactions, and read Collection definitions. Use for any task under database/ or any server code that touches data. Do not use for the NocoBase 2 @nocobase/database package.

nocobase-nocobase-app-app-skills-nocobas.description: Plan, build, deploy, verify, upgrade, and troubleshoot NocoBase 3 applications on an existing Studio or a standalone Node.js or Docker server. Use when an application must move from source to a deployment environment or when a deployment failure needs diagnosis.

nocobase-nocobase-libs-drive-nocobase-dr.description: Configure and use file storage with @nocobase/drive in NocoBase 3 applications, including local filesystem, S3-compatible storage, native Aliyun OSS, and custom driver factories. Use when changing drive configuration, storage credentials, file operations, or storage URLs. File Repository collections and upload permissions belong to the File plugin.

nocobase-nocobase-libs-realtime-nocobase.description: Design and implement live updates in NocoBase 3 applications and plugins using @nocobase/realtime, host client hooks and authorized server topics. Use for replacing business polling, snapshot recovery, task progress, personal notifications, streamed logs or multi-process fan-out. Not for OpenAI audio Realtime APIs.

nocobase-nocobase-app-app-skills-nocobas.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".
nocobase-nocobase-app-app-skills-nocobas.tools: Bash(npx shadcn@latest *), Bash(pnpm dlx shadcn@latest *), Bash(bunx --bun shadcn@latest *)
